title: code.issued
description: A page asked for a code to show beside the agent's phone number (POST /v1/codes): the four digits a caller keys to bind their call to that page. On the agent's own log, which is the table of codes: a gateway that starts reads back the ones still waiting.

CodeIssued.description: One code, waiting for the call that keys it.

env.description: The world the agent answers the phone in.

expires_at.description: When the code stops being one, unix seconds.

log.description: The projection the page reads the claimed call through.
